resources.string: Enter your PIN to see the files inside.
Choose a 4–12 digit PIN. Everything you add is encrypted with a key that never leaves this device.
Files are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) in the app\'s private storage. The key lives in this device\'s Keystore, so a copied file cannot be opened elsewhere.
No recovery: a forgotten PIN cannot be reset without losing the files
Import photos, videos or documents and they disappear from the rest of the phone.
